europe_now.title: Russian military helicopter breaches Polish airspace
europe_now.summary: Poland scrambled fighter jets following a breach of its airspace by a Russian helicopter originating from Kaliningrad. The incident highlights ongoing regional security tensions along Europe's eastern flank.

sources.headline: Poland scrambles jets after Russian helicopter breaches its airspace

europe_now.title: Poland and Belarus ministerial meeting
europe_now.summary: Foreign ministers from Poland and Belarus held a meeting for the first time in a decade to seek a thaw in diplomatic relations. The talks represent a notable shift in bilateral engagement between the neighboring states.

sources.headline: Poland and Belarus seek thaw in relations as foreign ministers meet for first time in a decade

top_stories.title: Escalation in Ukraine conflict
top_stories.summary: Russian forces launched intense ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv as residents prepared for harsh winter conditions. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told the United Nations General Assembly that Moscow is utilizing foreign fighters from dozens of countries.

sources.headline: Russia slams Kyiv with ballistic missiles as Ukrainians brace for harsh winter
